{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the first few rows
print(data.head())

# Check for internal QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, verify format: check if any revenue values have commas
print("Sample revenue values before conversion:", data['revenue'].head().values)

data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_data = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check if channel is balanced across loyal customers
print("Channel distribution among loyal customers:")
print(loyal_data['channel'].value_counts())

# Compute conversion rate for loyal customers
converted_loyal = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_data)
conversion_rate = converted_loyal / total_loyal

# Output result
conversion_rate"}
